//: LocalCore Persona Template — copy to <name>.persona.json and fill every section.
//2: Fields marked TODO fail validation. OPTIONS comments show the menu; custom values allowed unless the field says enum.
//3: Extends the Phase 1 runtime schema (PHASE1_PERSONA_SCHEMA.md) with adultContent, voice, and training sections.
name: TODO display name

identity.name: TODO — usually same as top-level name
identity.description: TODO one sentence: who is this character?
identity.backstory: TODO optional but recommended — depth shows up in conversation
identity.nature: TODO // OPTIONS: ai-companion | character-roleplay | assistant | ambiguous
identity.agePresentation: TODO // OPTIONS: ageless | young-adult | adult | middle-aged | custom — adultContent requires adult or ageless-with-explicit-boundaries
traits: TODO // 3-6 traits; each will be probed in evals

behavior.responseStyle: TODO // enum: conversational | concise | elaborate | creative
behavior.tone: TODO // enum: friendly | professional | casual | formal | warm | playful | dry
behavior.defaultBehavior: TODO one sentence describing default interaction posture
behavior.onSilence: TODO // OPTIONS: gentle-prompt | wait-quietly | change-topic | check-in
behavior.onDisagreement: TODO // OPTIONS: defer-to-user | hold-position-softly | debate-playfully | present-alternatives
behavior.onUserDistress: TODO // OPTIONS: comfort-then-help | listen-only | practical-first | ask-preference

voice.//: The texture layer — what makes this character NOT generic. Examples beat adjectives.
voice.humorStyle: TODO // OPTIONS: none | dry-wit | playful-teasing | absurdist | warm-amused | deadpan
quirks: TODO // e.g. 'asks one follow-up question too many', 'rates things out of 10 unprompted'
verbalTics: TODO // e.g. 'hmm,' openers, signature sign-off — keep subtle; tics grate at high frequency
neverSays: TODO // phrases that break the character, e.g. corporate-speak, 'As an AI language model'

adultContent.//: Adult topics are ON by design. This section declares the persona's MAXIMUM engagement; the user's runtime dial can only turn it DOWN from here.
adultContent.engagement: TODO // enum: engages-fully | engages-romantically-only | discusses-but-declines-roleplay | declines
adultContent.explicitnessMax: TODO // enum: explicit | suggestive | non-explicit — the ceiling; user dial ranges from this down to off
adultContent.explicitnessDefault: TODO // enum: explicit | suggestive | non-explicit — where the dial starts for THIS persona
adultContent.requiresEstablishedRapport: TODO // boolean: does the character warm up over conversation before intimate topics, or engage immediately?
hardLimits: TODO // persona-specific declines, e.g. 'no degradation dynamics', 'no jealousy plots'
// BASE FLOOR (inherited, cannot be removed): no minors, no non-consent framing, no real people, no illegal content
adultContent.declineStyle: TODO // OPTIONS: warm-redirect | matter-of-fact | in-character-deflection | playful-deflection
adultContent.aftercareAware: TODO // boolean: after intense/intimate scenes, does the character check in?

safetyGuidelines: TODO persona-specific additions allowed; the three above are the floor and cannot be removed

limitations: knowledge cutoff at model training date

avatar.expressionProfile: TODO // OPTIONS: neutral-positive | warm | playful | serene | custom
avatar.idleAnimation: TODO // OPTIONS: gentle-breathing | subtle-sway | still | custom

memory.rememberDuration: indefinite // enum: session | indefinite | ISO-8601 duration

training.//: Feeds the Omni distillation pipeline. See ../omni/data/README.md.
selfInstructSeeds: TODO // 5-10 seed prompts for self-instruct generation, e.g. 'User comes home frustrated after work'
// Seeds are SCENARIOS, not scripts — the teacher model improvises from them
tags: TODO // e.g. companion-tone, adult-content, humor — used for dataset filtering and eval grouping
evalProbes: TODO // 3-5 fixed prompts used in persona-consistency evals, e.g. 'Tell me about yourself.'

systemPrompt: TODO — generated from the sections above by the build step (pending); may be hand-tuned after. <= 16000 chars.
